seed: Nothing to set up: every file held over the window lives in the repo. Points are in window coordinates, measured down from the top-left corner, so they name spots that are NOT on the picture: the right hand panel, and the strip of chrome beside it.

steps.note: a text file held over the right hand panel: the window refuses it and the pointer shows the no-entry sign. Before this task it promised a copy and then nothing happened on release
any other file the app cannot place reads the same way, anywhere down the panel
a folder is refused too, the way the picture itself already refuses one
the strip of chrome between the picture and the panel answers the same, so there is no corner of the window left that promises something it will not do
a picture over the same spot is still taken, and letting go there adds it as a layer: the state line after this step counts one more layer than the step before it
and a picture straight after four refusals and a drop is taken normally, in the panel below the sections, so nothing about a refused file poisons the next drag
